items.title: Danang seizes thousands of counterfeit products from major fashion brands
items.summary: Danang police opened a criminal probe into industrial-property-rights infringement in An Hai Ward after two raids: a warehouse seizure of over 3,600 counterfeit items (Crocs, Adidas, Nike, Goyard, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Lacoste) and a second inspection on Tran Phu Street uncovering thousands more fakes spanning Gucci, Hermes, Hublot and other brands, worth an estimated billions of Vietnamese dong. Authorities flagged that the operator was a Vietnamese national acting as legal representative for a foreign principal, calling such structures 'particularly concerning.' Critical-angle item on the counterfeit pressure structurally weighing on Gucci brand equity in Vietnam.

items.title: Hanoi police seize fake Louis Vuitton and Gucci bags
items.summary: Hanoi police and market-surveillance authorities inspected a business in Kim Lien Ward and seized 19 counterfeit Louis Vuitton items and 5 fake Gucci pieces (handbags, wallets, clutches, belts) priced VND 2-10 million each, sold via Facebook since 2022. The investigation expanded to a manufacturing workshop in Thanh Liet Ward containing production machinery; estimated illicit profits reached roughly VND 4.2 billion since 2022, including VND 714 million from 129 items sold in 2026 alone. Direct critical-angle Gucci counterfeit story, freshest of the ongoing Vietnam crackdown wave this week.

items.title: Kering Q2 2026 earnings call: Gucci turnaround lifts shares, Asia-Pacific shows encouraging signs
items.summary: Transcript of Kering's Q2 2026 earnings call. CEO Luca de Meo said Gucci retail sales improved seven points sequentially in Q2 and 'all regions showed better trends,' with leather goods returning to growth on the Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches; comparable sales decline narrowed to 2% from 8% in Q1. Asia-Pacific showed 'encouraging signs of recovery' though mainland China remained the primary drag, requiring structural work beyond quick fixes. Retained as the primary global financial-context item still shaping SEA/APAC trade press framing of Gucci this cycle.
